title: Alexandria Grigsby
metaDescription: Meet Alexandria Grigsby, LCDC — clinical leadership at Dallas Detox Center, overseeing detox and dual diagnosis care on our private Texas campus.

blocks.html: I am the Clinical Director at Dallas Detox Center.  I assist with therapeutic and individualized treatment strategies to provide the best plan and treatment for individuals attempting to manage and maintain long term sobriety.
